description: Verdict returned by a build-loop checker: whether the round passes, the concrete fails with fixes when it does not, which check commands were run and their pass/fail outcome, and free-text notes.

pass.description: True only if every check ran and every fail-worthy rule held.

fails.description: Concrete, evidenced failures; empty when pass is true.

rule.description: The rule or requirement that was violated.

evidence.description: A file and line, a route, or a command output proving the violation.

fix.description: The concrete change that would resolve this fail.

checks.description: Which project commands ran this round and whether each passed.

extra.description: Result of commands.extra (all entries must pass).

e2e.description: Result of the job's commands.e2e spec.

paths.description: True if git status --porcelain shows no change outside the job's owned/allowed paths.

notes.description: Free-text summary a human or the next round can read at a glance.
